message.content:
I’m not able to look up your precise GPS coordinates right now, so I’ll suggest some quick ways you can find the closest pharmacy from wherever you’re standing:

| Option | How it works |
|--------|--------------|
| **Google Maps** (or Apple/MapQuest) | Type “pharmacy” or “drug store” into the search bar while you have Location Services turned on. It will list nearby options ranked by distance and show opening hours. |
| **Pharmacy‑chain apps** | If you prefer a particular brand—CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid, Boots, etc.—open its app or website and enable location services. They usually display the nearest outlet automatically. |
| **Ask Siri / Alexa / Google Assistant** | Say something like “Find the nearest pharmacy.” Your assistant will pull up a map view with the top results. |

### Quick examples of common chains around Los Angeles

| Chain | Typical locations in L.A. |
|-------|---------------------------|
| **Walgreens** | West Hollywood, Santa Monica, Downtown LA, Beverly Hills, Long Beach, Pasadena, Glendale, Burbank, Torrance… |
| **CVS Pharmacy** | Near UCLA (Westwood), Inglewood, South Bay (Redondo Beach, Manhattan Beach), North Hollywood, East LA, San Fernando Valley… |
| **Rite Aid** | Downtown LA, Koreatown, Mid-Wilshire, Fairfax District, El Segundo, Hawthorne… |
| **Boots (UK)** – *not* present in U.S.* | — |
| **Independent drugstores** | e.g., “Health Mart,” “Kroger Pharmacy,” “Safeway Pharmacy” often located inside grocery stores across the city. |

If you’d like more tailored help—for example, a phone number or address—I can try to guess which one might be closest based on a rough area you tell me (e.g., “near downtown”, “in Westside”). Just let me know!
